urdu transliteration: Gham mein dooba hoowa Karbal ka musaafir dekha
english translation text: I saw the traveller of Karbala drowned in grief

urdu transliteration: Rotay Shabbir ko Zahra ki lahad par dekha
english translation text: I saw Shabbir weeping at Zahra’s grave

urdu transliteration:
Apna sar maar ke deewaar se roya Ghazi
Jub Nabi zaadi ko aatay hooway baahar dekha
english translation text:
Ghazi struck his head against the wall and wept
When he saw the daughter of the Prophet being brought out

urdu transliteration:
Noor aankhon ka gaya qaatilon se poochay Hussain
Koi batlaaey kisi ne mera Akbar dekha
english translation text:
The light of my eyes is gone; Hussain asked the killers
Can anyone tell me, has anyone seen my Akbar?

urdu transliteration:
Door tak pheli hai Qasim ki javaani runn mein
Der tak dhoondta phir Sibte Payambar dekha
english translation text:
Qasim’s youth lay scattered far across the battlefield
For a long time, the grandson of the Prophet was seen searching for him

urdu transliteration:
Ravi likte hai ke Sajjad ko jab hosh aya
Jaltay khaiyam mein Zainab ka khulay sar dekha
english translation text:
The narrator writes that when Sajjad regained consciousness
In the burning tents, he saw Zainab with her head uncovered

urdu transliteration:
Ye Khuda jaanay ke zinda rahi ya mar gaee maa
Shah ke haathon pe hai jub laasha-e-Asghar dekha
english translation text:
Only God knows whether the mother remained alive or died
When she saw the body of Asghar in the hands of the Shah

urdu transliteration:
Saath baba ke hi mar gaee hai Sakina logo
Pyaasi gardan pe jo maasooma ne khanjar dekha
english translation text:
O people, Sakina died along with her father
When that innocent child saw the dagger upon his thirsty neck

urdu transliteration:
Ye fakat hausla tera hai mere Mola Hussain
Koi dafnaata na betay ko payambar dekha
english translation text:
This was only your courage, my Master Hussain
No prophet had ever been seen burying his own son

urdu transliteration:
Qaafla qaidiyon ka aa ke ruka maqtal mein
Be kaffan bhaiyon ne behnon ko khulay sar dekha
english translation text:
The caravan of prisoners came and stopped at the battlefield
The sisters, with uncovered heads, saw their brothers without shrouds

urdu transliteration:
Jub Hassan khoon se wuzu kar ke parrhi shah ne namaz
Sajda Shabbir ka Allah ne bhi aa kar dekha
english translation text:
When, O Hasan, the Shah performed prayer after making ablution with blood
Even Allah was witness to the prostration of Shabbir
